Package index

Methods of the author

Resampling methods developed by the package author. All oversamplers take a feature matrix and a factor class variable and return the resampled data together with the synthetic samples.

SMOTEWB()
SMOTE with Boosting (SMOTEWB, 2022)
MCSMOTE()
Markov Chain SMOTE (MCSMOTE, 2025)
BiSMOTE()
Bi-directional SMOTE (BiSMOTE, 2027)

Procedures built on a base method

DatRel moves synthetic samples back into their class region and can be applied to samples from any source. UGO uses a base oversampler together with a classifier.

DatRel()
Data Relocation (DatRel, 2025)
oversampleDatRel()
Oversampling followed by DatRel (2025)
UGO()
Uncertainty Guided Oversampling (UGO, 2026)

Performance evaluation

Data complexity measures

Measures of class imbalance, class overlap and noise, each as a separate function and all together through complexity().
